chunks: ʿAlī ibn Muḥammad, from Ḥamdān al-Qalānisī, who said:
I said to al-ʿAmrī, “Has Abū Muḥammad passed away?” So he said to me, “He has passed away, but he has left among you one whose neck is like this,” and he gestured with his hand.

key_terms.أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ: Abū Muḥammad, a title referring here to Imam al-Ḥasan al-ʿAskarī عليه السلام
key_terms.خَلَّفَ: left behind; indicates succession after his passing
key_terms.رَقَبَتُهُ: his neck; a physical expression used in the report’s indication
key_terms.فِيكُمْ: among you; indicating presence within the community
key_terms.قَدْ مَضَى: has passed away; indicates death or departure in this context
key_terms.وَأَشَارَ بِيَدِهِ: and he gestured with his hand; a non-verbal indication accompanying the statement

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith indicate the succession after Abū Muḥammad عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith reports an exchange after the passing of Abū Muḥammad عليه السلام, affirming that he was succeeded by one who remained among the people. It serves as an indication toward the continuation of the divinely appointed authority after him and is used in the context of the Imam al-Mahdī عليه السلام.
